name: The Maw of Knowing
visual_description: A massive, yawning creature, ringed in teeth. Its spiraled eye watches with indifference. Its scream is eternal, yet contains no sound.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh opened its mouth to me—not to speak, but to *swallow my certainty.* This is what it looked like: not monstrous, but *magnificent.* I entered willingly.
